scoring_justification: Only final summary JSON is output; raw eigenmode data is not a required artifact, so full recompute (T1) is infeasible. Result-level compare with threshold_or_better policy is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for shallow grating propagation loss and modal overlap
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.4 and abstract: alpha approx 2 cm^{-1}, gamma approx 0.4 for shallow grating (d=0.56 um, h_AR=8 um).
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from published paper values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported headline numbers for the scored condition.

outputs.description: Computed equivalent propagation loss and modal overlap for the specified shallow‑grating structure (h_AR = 8 μm, d = 0.56 μm, Λ = 14 μm, filling factor 50%).

steps.description: Check that the equivalent propagation loss alpha_cm1 is at most 4.0 cm⁻¹ (lower is better) and the modal overlap gamma is at least 0.3 (higher is better). Both conditions together yield full credit; partial credit is assigned monotonically outside these bounds.
